engine_warmup.optimized_plan:
Sort: [s_name Asc]
  Project: [s_name, s_address]
    INNER Join
      on: n_nationkey = s_nationkey
      Project: [nation.n_nationkey]
        Scan: nation [n_nationkey, n_name, n_regionkey, n_comment]
          projection: [0, 1]
          filter: (n_name = 'CANADA')
      SEMI Join
        on: s_suppkey = ps_suppkey
        Scan: supplier [s_suppkey, s_name, s_address, s_nationkey, s_phone, s_acctbal, s_comment]
          projection: [0, 1, 2, 3]
        Project: [ps_suppkey]
          Filter: (ps_availqty > CASE WHEN (IS NULL __scalar_present) THEN (0.5 * CAST(NULL AS Decimal128(38, 2))) ELSE __scalar_result END)
            LEFT Join
              on: ps_partkey = l_partkey AND ps_suppkey = l_suppkey
              SEMI Join
                on: ps_partkey = p_partkey
                Scan: partsupp [ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, ps_comment]
                  projection: [0, 1, 2]
                Project: [p_partkey]
                  Project: [part.p_partkey]
                    Scan: part [p_partkey, p_name, p_mfgr, p_brand, p_type, p_size, p_container, p_retailprice, p_comment]
                      projection: [0, 1]
                      filter: (p_name LIKE 'forest%')
              Project: [l_partkey, l_suppkey, 0.5 * SUM(l_quantity) AS __scalar_result, true AS __scalar_present]
                Project: [l_partkey, l_suppkey, (0.5 * SUM(l_quantity))]
                  Aggregate: group_by=[l_partkey, l_suppkey], aggs=[SUM(l_quantity)]
